items.text: Chicago acquired All-Pro DT Jeffery Simmons from Tennessee on Thursday for two first-round picks.

Chicago: RB Kyle Monangai (turf toe/thumb), CB Malik Muhammad (toe) and CB Tyrique Stevenson (hip) missed early-week practice; Ben Johnson called Monangai week-to-week. TE Cole Kmet is on season-ending IR.
Seattle acquired LG Quenton Nelson from Indianapolis on Oct. 27.

Seattle LT Charles Cross (high-ankle sprain) is expected to miss the game; Josh Jones starts. WR Rashid Shaheed (knee) had 'positive' early returns; RBs Zach Charbonnet and Jadarian Price (IR) are practicing, status TBD. First official report for the Monday game is due Thursday.
